newsitem.title: bulgaria: BULGARIAN POLICE CLEAR PATH OUT OF PARLIAMENT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN POLICE CLEAR PATH OUT OF PARLIAMENT.

text.p: Riot police fired blank cartridges and used clubs on Saturday to beat a path out of the besieged parliament for deputies from the ruling Socialist party.
Police cleared a path to buses parked outside the darkened parliament building, and deputies started leaving under a hail of stones thrown by opposition protesters.
Taxi drivers tried to block the route and protesters shouted "killers" as the deputies were escorted into buses.
Deputies of the opposition Union of Democratic Forces remained in the building. They have sworn to stay until their demand for a general election is met, did not leave with them.

Opposition supporters who attacked the parliament building on Friday during debate on a motion calling for early elections, kept vigil outside. Some security personnel have expressed sympathy for the protesters' cause.
Bulgarian President Zhelyu Zhelev said he would not ask the ex-communist ruling party to form a new government on Saturday as expected because of the protests.
